title: Fascinated by a beautiful dead face
description: Obsessive love and madness are separated by a very fine line. A romantic horror story about pure love drowning in a twisted form of love. Yoito was at the height of happiness after finally starting a relationship with his childhood friend, Nana. However, his peaceful days with the girl who loved him for who he truly was, without any ulterior motives, suddenly came crashing down after an accident. After witnessing Nana’s death, Yoito completely loses his composure. “I can save that girl for you.” Then, a mysterious woman suddenly appears and, to his horror, begins devouring Nana’s corpse… Is what this strange woman brings salvation, or an even worse hell? A twisted tale of horror and romance begins, where pure love and obsessive love intertwine!
author: Asahi Nishi
